value.feeder: OFF; never invoked by the bridge; feeder shapes are denied by shape
value.job_class_description: short, finite GPU bench/inference jobs submitted through the bridge, each declaring one output artifact under ~/jacquard-gpu-live/ on the Thor

policy.allow: known producer, governed class, no feeder / fetch shape: policy/1 allows the dispatch outright
policy.deny: feeder shapes and fetch-and-execute shapes are denied by shape, with the reason recorded
policy.hold: network-fetch shapes and unknown producers queue for a batched, hash-bound operator decision (tools/jq.py); a held job dispatches only after a release entry exists in the log

value.successor_rule: gpuq dispatches a finite job only with another job queued behind it or the feeder on; the live chain therefore always carries a named successor, and the window's last job is a declared sentinel that stays queued in gpuq
value.thor_route: per-dispatch SSH over the Thor's existing door only; zero new persistent processes or services on the Thor
